quiet_joint_loading.target: For each Gaussian velocity node j with normalized positive weight w_j, a shifted uniform phase lattice q_m=2*pi*(m+s_j)/M is mapped through theta+alpha*sin(theta)=q_m. Thus dq/dtheta=1+alpha*cos(theta)>0; it is a quadrature for the same separable initial density (1+alpha*cos(k*x))*f0(v), not a different temperature/alpha model.
quiet_joint_loading.weights: Carrier weight=L*w_j/M; increasing M leaves total weight L and deterministic velocity marginal unchanged. Every positive-weight carrier advances and deposits its own evolving self-consistent field.
quiet_joint_loading.cic_effect: CIC deposition/gather weights are continuous piecewise linear functions of particle position with grid-knot slope changes. Their composition with the density map and subsequent characteristics is sampled by the finite shifted lattice. Raising M can improve this spatial integration while leaving field mesh, shape order, velocity nodes and time step fixed.
quiet_joint_loading.limits: The low-mode load qualification does not establish exact CIC deposition at all grid modes/times. A small alpha=0 quiet-lattice floor does not bound perturbation-dependent alias/quadrature error. No exponential convergence, monotone reduction or particular algebraic order is proved here.
